desc:
Portal Sandbox is inspired by the show Rick And Morty (Game is still in beta and may have bugs)I also have other feautures planned as well so stay tuned

💻 Controls
T - Portal Gun
Q - Knife  (swipe to cut off limbs)
E - Regenerate
F  - Blender Dimension (Press before entering a portal)
X - Laser Pistol

Tags: RickAndMorty, Portals, PvP, Sandbox, Freeroam
